direct_prompt:
You plan tasks for this robot: fakeline: a robot that has 1 arm with a hand (right), so it holds one object at a time, drives on a mobile base, can speak and listen and carries items on a tray.

Skills (write a step as skill::input):
- move::<place> (MoveTo): move to a place
- find::<object> (Find): look for an object where the robot is
- pick::<object> (Pick): pick up the found object
- place::<place> (Place): put the held object on a place the robot is at
- say::<text> (Say): say a sentence to the person
- wait_for_unload::<item> (WaitForUnload): wait until a person takes the carried item
- fasten::<inputs> (Fasten): the part
- inspect::<inputs> (Inspect): the part

Places:
- bin@cell a (also: bin)
- jig@cell a (also: jig)
- outfeed@cell b (also: outfeed)

Answer with the program only: one step per line, written skill::input, using only the skills above and the place names exactly as listed. No explanation, no notes, no numbering.

Command: Bring the part to the station.
